features.text: Premium lightweight aluminum construction supports up to 250 lbs while remaining easy to maneuver
Quick-adjust push button mechanism allows precise height adjustment from 30" to 39"
Ergonomically designed handle with convenient hook feature for hands-free moments
Versatile design accommodates users from 4'5" to 6'5" tall for universal comfort
Non-slip base provides enhanced stability on various surfaces

measurement: For optimal stability and support, proper height adjustment is crucial. Measure from your wrist to the floor while standing with your arms relaxed at your sides. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for expert assistance in achieving the perfect fit for your recovery needs.
